title: An integrated framework identified potent inhibitors targeting IRE1alpha.
authors: Divya, Subramaniyan; Talwar, Priti; Ravanan, Palaniyandi
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接筛选靶向IRE1alpha激酶的黄酮类抑制剂，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Inositol-requiring enzyme 1 (IRE1alpha) is one of the key sensors and signaling effectors of the unfolded protein response (UPR), which is essential for preserving endoplasmic reticulum (ER) homeostasis. Dysregulation of IRE1alpha signaling can lead to several illnesses. Initially, we employed the multidocking approach utilizing AutoDock Vina, AutoDock Wizard, and iGEMDOCK to predict the accurate binding affinities of the flavonoid library against IRE1alpha and rank them based on their affinities. Subsequently, post-docking approaches were used to refine the hit selection. Finally, the top-ranked flavonoids were selected based on their consistent high binding affinity and exhibited strong binding within the ATP-binding pocket of the kinase active site. In vitro kinase assays revealed that both amentoflavone and glycitein significantly inhibited IRE1alpha kinase activity, with IC(50) values of 16.4 muM and 23.68 muM, respectively. Cell-based studies demonstrated that these flavonoids have anti-inflammatory properties and significantly promote robust activation of XBP1 splicing and IRE1alpha expression under normal conditions. In contrast, flavonoid pretreatment significantly attenuated LPS-induced IRE1alpha-XBP1 signaling and reduced inflammatory responses. Overall, our results indicate that both glycitein and amentoflavone exhibit promising modulatory effects on IRE1alpha. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to report the modulatory potential of flavonoids amentoflavone and glycitein to possess both IRE1alpha kinase inhibitory and RNase-activating properties. This work provides a valuable basis for the development of flavonoid-based IRE1alpha inhibitors to treat ER stress and associated inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 肌醇需求酶1（IRE1alpha）是未折叠蛋白反应（UPR）的关键传感器和信号效应器之一，对于维持内质网（ER）稳态至关重要。IRE1alpha信号传导的失调可导致多种疾病。首先，我们采用多对接方法，利用AutoDock Vina、AutoDock Wizard和iGEMDOCK预测黄酮类化合物库对IRE1alpha的精确结合亲和力，并根据其亲和力进行排序。随后，使用对接后方法优化命中化合物的选择。最后，基于一致的高结合亲和力及其在激酶活性位点的ATP结合口袋内的强结合能力，选出了排名靠前的黄酮类化合物。体外激酶实验显示，穗花杉双黄酮（amentoflavone）和大豆黄酮（glycitein）均显著抑制IRE1alpha激酶活性，其IC(50)值分别为16.4 μM和23.68 μM。基于细胞的研究表明，这些黄酮类化合物具有抗炎特性，并在正常条件下显著促进XBP1剪接的强效激活和IRE1alpha表达。相反，黄酮类化合物预处理显著减弱了脂多糖（LPS）诱导的IRE1alpha-XBP1信号传导，并减少了炎症反应。总体而言，我们的结果表明，大豆黄酮和穗花杉双黄酮对IRE1alpha均表现出有前景的调节作用。据我们所知，这是首次报道黄酮类化合物穗花杉双黄酮和大豆黄酮具有IRE1alpha激酶抑制和RNase激活双重特性的调节潜力。这项工作为开发基于黄酮类化合物的IRE1alpha抑制剂以治疗内质网应激及相关炎症性疾病提供了宝贵的基础。
